concerns.title: Common Questions Families Ask After SPM Results
concerns.subtitle: Choosing the next step after SPM is a meaningful family decision. Here are the practical concerns parents most frequently raise before enrolling.

items.title: Varying Registration & Upfront Costs
items.description: Many families look for structured vocational education without having to pay the entire programme fee in a single lump sum at registration.

items.title: Clarity on Real-World Career Prospects
items.description: Parents want to know their child is learning practical skills aligned with real operational demand rather than purely abstract theory.

items.title: Matching the Course to Your Child’s Strengths
items.description: Not every school leaver thrives in traditional lecture-heavy tracks. Many excel in hands-on operations, coordination, and team workflows.

items.title: Comfort & Support When Studying Away From Home
items.description: Parents rightly ask about the study atmosphere, student support structures, and daily learning environment before committing.

logistics.title: What Do Students Actually Learn in Logistics?
logistics.subtitle: Logistics keeps goods moving smoothly—from e-commerce fulfilment centres and stockrooms to port freight documentation and daily delivery coordination.

pillars.title: Warehouse & Fulfilment Operations
pillars.description: Understanding racking layout, inbound goods receiving, storage zoning, and safe material handling practices.

pillars.title: Inventory Control & Barcode Tracking
pillars.description: Monitoring stock levels, scanning barcodes, reconciling inbound/outbound records, and maintaining accurate inventory logs.

pillars.title: Distribution & Transport Coordination
pillars.description: Scheduling deliveries, planning domestic distribution routes, preparing consignment documents, and coordinating with carriers.

pillars.title: Supply Chain Fundamentals
pillars.description: Seeing how suppliers, manufacturers, distribution hubs, and end customers connect across an integrated supply chain.

careers.title: Areas Graduates Can Explore After Completion
careers.subtitle: Training in logistics prepares graduates to apply for a variety of operational support roles, depending on individual performance and employer hiring needs.
careers.disclaimer: Transparent note: The roles below represent potential industry career pathways and do not constitute guaranteed job placements.

roles.title: Warehouse & Fulfilment Operations
roles.description: Supporting goods receiving, parcel inspection, stock put-away, and accurate customer order dispatch.

roles.title: Inventory Control Assistant
roles.description: Tracking daily stock balances, assisting with cycle counts, and maintaining warehouse management system records.

roles.title: Logistics & Dispatch Coordinator
roles.description: Coordinating delivery schedules, transport paperwork, and communication between warehouse teams and clients.

roles.title: Supply Chain Support
roles.description: Assisting procurement teams, monitoring supplier shipment timelines, and compiling operational movement reports.

faq.title: Straightforward Answers for Parents & Students
faq.subtitle: Current intake schedules, fees, and campus specifics are confirmed directly by GIS advisors.

items.a: Yes, GIS offers instalment payment options to help families manage education expenses steadily. For exact monthly schedules and current registration terms, please contact a GIS advisor to confirm.

items.q: How does PTPK financing work, and is approval guaranteed?
items.a: Skills Development Fund Corporation (PTPK) financing is subject to current eligibility criteria, quota availability, and official approval. A GIS advisor can walk you through the initial eligibility requirements before enrolment.

items.q: What are the entry requirements and programme duration?
items.a: The programme is designed for SPM leavers and young Malaysians interested in practical logistics skills. For exact programme duration, upcoming intake dates, and specific entry requirements, please contact a GIS advisor to confirm.

items.q: Where is the campus located and is student accommodation available?
items.a: Current campus location details, nearby public transport links, and verified accommodation or student safety arrangements are provided directly during your consultation. Please contact a GIS advisor to confirm.

items.q: Does GIS guarantee job placement after graduation?
items.a: GIS focuses on practical skills training and career readiness support such as CV preparation and interview coaching. Career outcomes depend on individual performance and employer hiring needs; we do not guarantee job placement.

items.q: Can parents speak with an advisor before deciding?
items.a: Yes, of course. We encourage parents and guardians to reach out via the WhatsApp enquiry form on this page to ask questions calmly with no obligation to register.

privacyModal.title: GIS Course Enquiry Privacy Notice
paragraphs: Global Institute of Studies (GIS) respects the privacy of parents, guardians, and prospective students enquiring about our Logistics course.

The information you enter (Full Name, Mobile Phone Number, and Email Address) is used solely to prepare your prefilled WhatsApp enquiry addressed to an official GIS advisor (+60 11-3181 2004) for course guidance, instalment planning, and preliminary PTPK eligibility enquiries.
Your message is only transmitted when you actively press Send inside WhatsApp. Personal contact details are never sent to page analytics.
To request a copy of our full institutional privacy policy or update your contact details, please notify your GIS admissions advisor directly.
